propositions: Production outbound CREATEs lack prerequisite metadata because current emission path loses `requires_create` and `requires_parent` before the planner receives typed `Mutation` objects

The existing single-create coordinator in `create_route` does not order parent and child creates; a new focused per-pass create scheduler must own inter-create dependency ordering at the batch sequencer
Prerequisite and provider identities must use local ticket IDs exclusively; `Mutation.target` must equal the local ID advertised to dependents, never a Jira key for unbound tickets

The new create scheduler must execute eligible homogeneous outbound-create plans in planner dependency order through `apply_handlers.handle_create`, then remove only consumed creates from the legacy batch loop, recording outcomes (confirmed/dependency_deferred) in manifest/tally

A confirmed parent create releases dependents only after local-ID-to-Jira binding and containment confirmation; permanent failure, `commit_unknown`, budget defer, or unconfirmed containment hold dependents as `dependency_deferred` with no vendor create call

The batch and typed create adapters must expose equivalent `confirmed`/`dependents_released` signals without dual-send or second route selector, keeping `create_route` as sole owner of persistence/containment/rollback while scheduler owns inter-create ordering
